rawMetrics.name: Reactions
rawMetrics.description: Also called Likes on X. This shows how many people reacted to your post.

rawMetrics.name: Comments
rawMetrics.description: The number of comments your post received. Shows when your post is starting conversations, not just getting seen.

rawMetrics.name: Eng. Rate
rawMetrics.description: The percentage of people who interacted with your post compared to how many saw it. Balances views and actions to show how compelling your posts are.

rawMetrics.name: Reposts
rawMetrics.description: Also called Retweets on X. This shows how many times your post was reposted by others. A sign your content is reaching beyond your immediate audience.

rawMetrics.name: Impressions
rawMetrics.description: How many times your post was shown on screen. This can include multiple views by the same person. Useful for spotting how often your content gets surfaced.

rawMetrics.name: Clicks
rawMetrics.description: How many times people clicked on your post or link. Shows when your content drives action beyond the channel it's on.
